author: More Perfect Union
description:
"I don't want to drive housing prices down, I want to drive housing prices up." - Donald Trump

He's doing exactly that. Tariffs and the Iran War are making home costs soar.

Iron, wood, diesel, asphalt, mortgages – it's all more expensive than it was when Trump took office.

Host: trevorp_hayes
Co-Producer: Lucy Dean Stockton
Co-Producer: trevorp_hayes
Editor: Kunga Choephel
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How the Iran War made housing even more expensive
